title: Boris IR graph.json (v0.4)
description: Machine-readable twin of the `graph.json` section of docs/contracts/ir-schema.md for a corpus that carries Cooklang recipes. The prose contract remains normative. Identical to v0.2 except that every node gains a `recipe` field, and `relations` is present when the corpus also carries semantic relations. Node bodies are deliberately absent: nodes carry bodyOffset only, and consumers re-read source from sourcePath.

frozen.description: true only after a successful graph freeze; graph.json is not published otherwise.

nodes.description: Full node objects sorted by id.

edges.description: Direct authored edges only — no transitive include closure. Sorted by (from.type, from.value, to.type, to.value, kind); array position is the stable edge index used by reverseIndex.

reverseIndex.description: One entry per distinct endpoint appearing as an edge `to`. Targets with no incoming edge are omitted. Sorted by (target.type, target.value).

nav.description: One entry per page, same order as nodes (entity id ascending).

relations.description: Present only when the corpus carries author semantic relations (the IR 0.3 facet). Same shape as `edges`; never used for build dependency walks.

endpoint.description: Key order: type, value. Values never contain an absolute path; `source` uses / separators.

type.description: `page` = a node in this graph; `source` = file bytes consumed via {{include}}, not promoted to a page.

node.description: Key order: index, id, sourcePath, role, parent, parentIndex, title, status, tags, bodyOffset, recipe. There is no `body` field.

tags.description: May be empty; author order preserved.

bodyOffset.description: Byte offset of body start in the source file.

recipe.description: null for a page that carries no recipe. Present on every node once any page in the corpus does.

kind.description: Closed v0.2 set. `parent`: page->page. `include`: page|source -> source. `reference`: page|source -> page. `layout` and `asset` are not valid IR edge kinds.

incomingEdges.description: Ascending indices into the sorted edges array; never omitted, no duplicates.

navEntry.description: Key order: index, id, breadcrumb, children, siblings. Empty arrays are written as [], never omitted.

breadcrumb.description: Parent chain root -> self inclusive, as node indices.

children.description: Direct child node indices, entity id ascending.

siblings.description: Other direct children of the immediate parent, excluding self; empty for a root Trunk.

cookQuantity.description: Amount and unit exactly as authored. Both are strings and either may be empty: Cooklang admits `2`, `1/2`, `1.5`, `1-2` and bare words, so the compiler never converts a quantity to a number and never rounds one.

cookIngredient.description: One ingredient reference, in authored order. References are never merged: see the recipe field description.

name.description: Display name. For a recipe reference, the final path segment.

preparation.description: Short-hand preparation from `(...)`; empty when absent.

recipeRef.description: Entity id of the referenced recipe when the author wrote `@./path/Name`, else null. Joinable against `nodes[].id`.

cookCookware.description: One cookware reference, in authored order.

cookTimer.description: One timer reference, in authored order.

cookRecipe.description: Structured recipe extracted from a `.cook` page. Every list preserves authored order and holds one entry per reference; two `@flour` references are not merged, because adding `200%g` to `1%cup` is not decidable without a unit model.

semanticRelation.description: One author semantic relation, reshaped as an edge. Never used for build dependency walks. `kind` is author-defined, unlike a dependency edge's closed set.

kind.description: Author-defined token matching `page.RelationKind.parse`: lowercase start, then lowercase, digits or `_`, at most `max_relation_kind_bytes` (64) bytes.
